per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Accepted with cautions: DBAASP assay/experiment rows are matched to Table 3 when values agree; cyclic peptide records preserve sequence_modified_not_normalized; the c-PKFI/B. cereus value conflict is retained as source_conflict.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Accepted with cautions at final worker-6 layer: all non-dash Table 3 peptide MIC cells and positive controls are recorded with units and locators; dash cells are not fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Accepted with cautions: no direct mechanism assay is claimed; SAR/background statements are treated as context only.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: Accepted_with_cautions after worker-4/6 source review closed rwk-complete-test-0001 and left no blocking or major quality-feedback issue.

caution_findings.note: Packet still carries material_extracted_with_gaps from the message-transfer test, but XML/PDF/OA package/database surfaces needed for worker-4/6 rework were reopened and the remaining missing local supplementary dataset does not block Table 3/database adjudication.

The prior parser output captured only 42 Table 3 MIC cells; worker-6 final activity now records all 66 source-supported peptide MIC values plus 6 control MIC values and tracks dash cells as not reported.

One duplicated DBAASP c-PKFI/B. cereus row remains source_conflict because primary Table 3 reports 62.25 while the database and prose report 62.5; cyclic peptide sequence rows preserve sequence_modified_not_normalized rather than pretending cyclization is encoded in the one-letter sequence.
The paper provides antimicrobial MIC testing and SAR rationale, not a direct membrane-disruption or molecular mechanism assay; mechanism output is context-only.
Primary Table 3 abbreviated labels K. pneumonia and T. mentagrophyte are preserved in activity rows while database full-species labels are crosswalked for row matching.
